title: Runtime Skill Audit: Targeted Runtime Probing for Agent Skill Security
title_zh: Runtime Skill Audit：面向 Agent Skill 安全的定向运行时探测
abstract_en: Agent skills let LLM agents reuse instructions, resources, tools, and workflows, but they also create a new place for malicious behavior to hide. A skill may look benign in its documentation or code while becoming harmful only when it is invoked with particular user requests, local assets, persistent state, or multi-step tool interactions. This makes purely static vetting brittle. We present Runtime Skill Audit (RSA), a dynamic analysis method that audits skills by asking what the skill-mediated agent actually does under targeted runtime conditions. Instead of testing every skill with the same generic tasks, RSA profiles risk-relevant interfaces, prepares the execution context needed to exercise them, and assigns security labels from the resulting trace evidence. We instantiate RSA on OpenClaw and evaluate it on 100 skills against representative static baselines. RSA achieves 90.0\% accuracy with an 88.0\% true positive rate and an 8.0\% false positive rate, improving accuracy by 13.0 percentage points over the best static baseline. Under self-evolving attacks, static detectors collapse after one or two rounds, while RSA continues to detect 19--20 out of 20 malicious skills across rounds.
abstract_zh: 本文关注 LLM Agent 中的 skill 安全问题。Agent skills 可复用指令、资源、工具与工作流，但也为恶意行为提供了新的隐藏位置：某个 skill 在文档或代码层面可能看似良性，却会在特定用户请求、本地资产、持久状态或多步工具交互下表现出危害性，使纯静态审查变得脆弱。作者提出 Runtime Skill Audit（RSA），一种动态分析方法，通过构造有针对性的运行时条件，审计由 skill 介导的 Agent 实际行为。RSA 不对所有 skill 使用通用任务测试，而是分析与风险相关的接口，准备触发这些接口所需的执行上下文，并基于运行轨迹证据分配安全标签。作者在 OpenClaw 上实现 RSA，并在 100 个 skills 上与代表性静态基线比较。RSA 达到 90.0% 准确率、88.0% 真阳性率和 8.0% 假阳性率，相比最佳静态基线准确率提升 13.0 个百分点。在自演化攻击场景下，静态检测器在一到两轮后失效，而 RSA 在多轮中仍能检测出 20 个恶意 skills 中的 19–20 个。
key_points_zh: 提出 Runtime Skill Audit（RSA），将 skill 安全审计从静态代码/文档检查转向基于实际运行轨迹的动态分析。
RSA 会识别风险相关接口，构造特定用户请求、资产、状态与工具交互上下文，以触发潜在恶意行为。
在 OpenClaw 上评估 100 个 skills，RSA 获得 90.0% accuracy、88.0% true positive rate 和 8.0% false positive rate。
相比最佳静态基线，RSA 准确率提升 13.0 个百分点，说明其更能发现条件触发型恶意 skill。
在 self-evolving attacks 中，静态检测器很快崩溃，而 RSA 多轮仍能检出 19–20/20 个恶意 skills，表现出更强鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant runtime security audit method for agent skills that uses trace evidence under targeted execution conditions.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的智能体技能运行时安全审计方法，利用特定执行条件下的轨迹证据进行检测。
